title: Tirranun: Fanning the Flames
summary: Tirranun survives his first defeat and returns in a stronger form.
overview: Tirranun survives his first defeat and returns in a stronger form.

phases.label: Recovery
phases.description: Tirranun becomes protected and regenerates while ash adds appear.

phases.label: Renewed assault
phases.description: Tirranun returns with increased health and damage, faster adds and further area attacks.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Keep a backup tank ready for banishment of the top-threat target in the opening fight.
The first apparent death begins a recovery period; continue controlling the ash adds.
As Tirranun regenerates, add spawns accelerate before he becomes attackable again.
Spread healing coverage for his recurring area attacks and respect the unstable bridge approach.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 5.
